title: Fraternal
summary: FRATERN'AL, adjective [Latin fraternus, from frater, brother.] Brotherly; pertaining to brethren; becoming brothers; as fraternal love or affection; a fraternal embrace.

inlines.v: FRATERN'AL, adjective [Latin fraternus, from frater, brother.] Brotherly; pertaining to brethren; becoming brothers; as fraternal love or affection; a fraternal embrace.
